connector.none: no connector: the feeds are public URLs, fetched over http on the Claude side

reads.note: RSS Feed Read v1.1, once per feed URL (6 items from Split Out): rss-parser GETs the URL and parses RSS 2.0 or Atom (The Verge). rss-parser fetches with Node's own http(s) client; whether that honours the bench proxy is unverified

connector.none: embeddings stay with the provider; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: Store News Articles (in-memory insert) embeds every chunk with POST /v1/embeddings. The reply carries 7 vectors, one per article (each article is under the 3,000-character chunk size): LangChain reads one vector per input, so the same reply serves one batched call or one call per item. Vectors are synthetic

branches: no IF/Switch: 6 feed reads → 7 normalized articles → one in-memory insert
expect.offline: The daily trigger is fixtured because it is the path that reads the outside world. Send Weekly Summary's agent reads only the in-process store (memoryKey news_store_key) that earlier daily runs filled, so a single run cannot exercise it: Get News Articles is left unlisted (validate warns) and Send Newsletter (sendTo the placeholder your@email.com, an overlay) is not reached. Store News Articles writes to n8n's process memory, which neither side can observe as an outgoing effect
